title: Phase II Trial of Amivantamab Plus Monochemotherapy in Platinum Unfit NSCLC Patients With EGFR exon20 Insertion Mutations.
official: Phase II Trial of Amivantamab Plus Monochemotherapy in Platinum Unfit NSCLC Patients With EGFR exon20 Insertion Mutations.
summary: To assess safety and efficacy of amivantamab plus monochemotherapy in terms of ORR, PFS and OS in subjects with EGFR exon20 insertion mutations metastatic non-small cell lung cancer unfit for platinum-based chemotherapy.
conditions: Metastatic NSCLC - Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

sites.f: I.F.O. Istituti Fisioterapici Ospitalieri Istituto Nazionale Tumori "Regina Elena", Medical Oncology 2
